1.explanation:
- DatePicker/DatePicker.mdx: Shows the base DatePicker markup, usage examples, and accessibility guidelines (including keyboard behavior expectations).
- DatePicker/migrate-to-7.x.md: Documents past changes to keyboard handling in the DatePicker’s icon vs. input triggers—useful for spotting regressions.
- DatePicker/next/DatePicker.mdx: Describes any upcoming or experimental focus management logic in the next major version, which may highlight fixes.
- TextInput/TextInput.mdx: The DatePicker input extends TextInput; its focus behavior and props determine how keyboard events are routed.
- Popover/README.md and Popover/next/Popover.mdx: The calendar is rendered inside a Popover. These docs define how focus is managed when the trigger opens the overlay, and what keyboard support is expected in popover content.

Together, these documents cover the component composition (TextInput + IconButton + Popover), focus/keyboard handling on open, and any recent or upcoming changes—providing all the context needed to understand and reproduce the focus/keyboard navigation bug.
1.bug_scenario: The issue occurs in the Carbon DatePicker component when the calendar icon trigger (an IconButton) is clicked to open the date-selection popover. In the first scenario (opened by icon click) the calendar overlay appears without moving focus into the popup or back onto the text input (no visible focus ring), so pressing the arrow keys does nothing. In the second scenario (opened by clicking directly into the text input) the input retains focus (blue outline), and arrow keys correctly navigate through dates in the overlay. The bug is therefore a focus management regression when opening via the icon button.
